description: Driven by innovation, we are a multidisciplinary team for NASA Space Apps. Led by Zainab (AppsClub VP, data analytics and web development), our crew includes Rida (storytelling & pitch), Afaf & Othmane (game/interactive design and coding), and Houda & Issam (cybersecurity & backend). We fuse spatial data analytics, secure architecture, and user-centered design into impactful open-source solutions.
